definitions.explanation: The polite/honorific form of {確認|かくにん}, used in business correspondence, customer service, and formal requests to ask someone to check or confirm something.

examples.japanese: ご{確認|かくにん}ください。
{内容|ないよう}のご{確認|かくにん}をお{願|ねが}いいたします。
examples.english: I would appreciate your confirmation of the contents.

examples.japanese: ご{確認|かくにん}いただけましたでしょうか。
examples.english: Have you had a chance to check?

examples.japanese: {添付|てんぷ}ファイルをご{確認|かくにん}の{上|うえ}、ご{返信|へんしん}ください。
examples.english: Please review the attached file and reply.

notes:
The honorific form of {確認|かくにん} (confirmation), created by adding the prefix ご. One of the most frequently used polite expressions in Japanese business email. Nearly every business email in Japan includes ご{確認|かくにん} in some form.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ご{確認|かくにん}ください: please check (standard polite)
- ご{確認|かくにん}のほどお{願|ねが}いいたします: I kindly request your confirmation (very polite)
- ご{確認|かくにん}いただけますか: could you please check? (polite request)
- ご{確認|かくにん}の{上|うえ}: after checking; upon confirmation
- ご{確認|かくにん}いただきありがとうございます: thank you for confirming

BUSINESS EMAIL CONTEXT:
Used when sending documents, proposals, schedules, or any information that requires the recipient's review. Part of the standard set of ご + noun expressions in business Japanese.

OTHER COMMON ご + NOUN PATTERNS IN BUSINESS EMAIL:
- ご{連絡|れんらく}: contact/communication
- ご{検討|けんとう}: consideration
- ご{返信|へんしん}: reply
- ご{報告|ほうこく}: report
